TRANSPARENT ENGINEERING POLICY & STANDARD EXCLUSIONS

In alignment with international ISO/IS rigging standards, our warranty guarantees manufacturer craftsmanship, genuine Japanese SS316 raw materials, and on-site tension anchoring. It excludes:

• Deliberate cutting with heavy bolt cutters, wire cutters, or power saws.
• Direct flame exposure, fireworks, or chemical muriatic acid washes on balcony tiles.
• Unauthorized modifications, re-drilling, or unhooking by third-party carpenters/painters.
• Major structural building collapse, severe wall settlement cracks, or earthquake damage.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Warranty Questions

Straightforward, practical information about invisible grill installation, balcony safety, and building society approvals.

Will the wires rust or discolour over time? +
No. Invisible Safety uses virgin SS316 marine-grade steel containing molybdenum, which prevents corrosion even in humid coastal areas like Visakhapatnam. The outer transparent nylon coating additionally shields against dust, UV rays, and moisture.
What warranty do you offer on invisible grills and safety nets? +
We provide a comprehensive up to 10-year warranty on SS316 invisible grill cables and track integrity, and a 2 to 3-year anti-sag and UV degradation warranty on high-density HDPE safety nets. Additionally, we provide one complimentary re-tensioning inspection within the first 3 months.
